checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add WAV health diagnostics

impact_assessment.why: analyze reports peak and RMS but not clipping, silence, DC offset, zero crossings or crest factor, which are needed to judge a rendered file.
impact_assessment.benefits: health prints those deterministic metrics for any Coda WAV, with exact counts and stable formatting.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: counts must be exact on crafted signals, crest factor and DC stable, silence finite, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests pinning the full deterministic report on two crafted signals, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 329 tests green; exact counts, stable formatting and silence handling pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-health' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a pedal-point drone transform

impact_assessment.why: Harmonize adds voices per note but there is no way to anchor a score with one sustained bass note spanning its whole length.
impact_assessment.benefits: pedal appends a single drone at the score's first beat covering its full span, with chosen pitch and velocity and no changes to existing notes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: pitch must parse, velocity 0..1, span must be positive, existing notes untouched, output round-trips; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for span, pitch, velocity and preservation, a CLI command with --note/--velocity, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 334 tests green; span, pitch, velocity, preservation and round-trip pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-pedal' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add pitch snapping to a scale

impact_assessment.why: quantize snaps note timing to a grid but there is no way to snap pitches into a key, so hand-written melodies cannot be made diatonic.
impact_assessment.benefits: snap-scale moves every sounding pitch to the nearest degree of the chosen scale and root, preserving rhythm and timbre as editable source.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: root must parse, scale must be valid, nearest degree with lower-on-tie, results in MIDI range, round-trip and rests skipped; dependency: std only, reuse gen::Scale; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for degree snapping, tie-breaking, preservation and round-trip, a CLI command reusing --scale/--root, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 339 tests green; nearest-degree snapping, tie-breaking and round-trip pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-snap-scale' completed successfully.
checkpoints.head: 0780f9b217c94a99396a8021e8ca113edd94824d

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add WAV splice at a time offset

impact_assessment.why: pad inserts silence and mix adds signals, but there is no way to insert one WAV into another at a chosen time while keeping the original tail.
impact_assessment.benefits: splice places a WAV at an exact frame offset inside another, shifting the remaining audio unchanged, with zero-padding beyond the source end.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rates must match, offset non-negative and rounded to frames, head/tail bytes preserved, gap zero-filled, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for insertion, padding, rate validation and exact frame counts, a two-WAV CLI command with --at, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 344 tests green; exact insertion, zero padding and tail preservation pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-splice' completed successfully.
checkpoints.head: 8bec9adfaed4fbc9e0103bb6662e54efa1f16980

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a one-pole low-pass filter for WAVs

impact_assessment.why: No tool can smooth harsh high-frequency content in a rendered WAV; existing effects only modulate amplitude, delay or resolution.
impact_assessment.benefits: lowpass applies a deterministic one-pole filter per channel with a smoothing coefficient, keeping frame count and rate, with coefficient 1 byte-identical.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: coefficient 0..1, coefficient 1 identity, coefficient 0 holds the first sample, deterministic state, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for identity, freeze, smoothing and determinism, a CLI command with --alpha, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 349 tests green; identity, freeze, step response and determinism pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-lowpass' completed successfully.
checkpoints.head: a4e6c81a0dc5137b11776744b9458a669b170aa6

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add static equal-power panning for WAVs

impact_assessment.why: autopan sweeps the image over time and width folds or widens it, but there is no way to place a finished WAV at a fixed stereo position.
impact_assessment.benefits: pan applies an equal-power constant gain per channel from a fixed -1..1 position, with centre byte-identical and full positions isolating a side.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: pan must be finite -1..1, centre identity exact, hard left/right silence the opposite channel, deterministic, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for centre identity, hard sides, equal-power balance and determinism, a CLI command with --pan, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 354 tests green; centre identity, hard-side isolation and bounded gains pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-pan' completed successfully.
checkpoints.head: 77bb31497d27e28690264ed16b6e742bef92b8c8

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a one-pole high-pass filter for WAVs

impact_assessment.why: lowpass can remove harsh top end but there is no complementary tool to remove rumble and slow drift while keeping the higher content.
impact_assessment.benefits: highpass subtracts a one-pole low-pass state from the signal per channel, keeping frame count and rate, with alpha 1 producing silence and alpha 0 a DC-shifted copy.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: alpha 0..1, alpha 1 all-zero output, alpha 0 equals input minus its first sample, deterministic, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for the two edge coefficients, step response and determinism, a CLI command reusing --alpha, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 359 tests green; first difference, DC removal, constant-signal silence and determinism pinned by byte tests
